<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex071032026-10-1509-35-49" status="unreviewed">  <milestone n="lo tsha ba" unit="section"/>
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs>'i rang lugs ni mkhyen pa 3 yon tan kyi spyi yin te yul ni rnam pa 2 po rgyu zhes zer bas kyang yul du bshad tsa na yul nyid spyin yin pas na spyi shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu yin la dngos po lnga ni skye med rnam za
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="11b3"/> sgog pa'i rdal 'byoir ba'i gnas skabs rnam kun mon rdzogs kyi goms pa yul byung gi rnam pa thob pa rtse mo | 
               go mes su brgol mthar gyis pa | de rab du gyung pa ska 1 ma | yongs su smin pa chos sku yin pas cu'i thigs pa lta bu yin la | de rgya mtsho chen po'i bang du bu'i thigs pa 'du ba ltar | mkhyen gsum gyi na du dngos po sta' bdu bas mkhyen gsum <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="11b4"/>phyag gi yul du gzhag pa la nyes pa mi don zer ro || </seg></TEI>
